verdict.rationale: telli can be driven without its UI. A REST API authenticated by a bearer API key lets you manage contacts and schedule calls programmatically, and a probe confirmed a published OpenAPI spec. Scheduled workflow triggers run without a call event, and webhooks push call events to your systems, which together support unattended automation. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-specific tooling (e.g. GitHub Actions), documented CI/headless usage examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
